en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a dramatic rocky landscape along a large river. A single‑track railway line runs through tall, narrow basalt rock spires, one of which has a lone tree growing from its top. Telegraph poles follow the tracks. On the right is an open riverside plain sloping down to the broad river, with more isolated rock pinnacles scattered across it. Forested hills and headlands fade into the mist in the distance. Handwritten notes appear along the right margin in cursive script.
